description: Fetch a persisted consensus/ask-all session record by id (opinions, verdict, arbiter, annotations). Requires sessions.persist; local and read-only (no provider calls). Returns a text-wrapped JSON envelope { session }, or { error } when persistence is off or the id is unknown.

cwd.description: session-revisit only: working directory for resolving the original file refs on the re-run; session-get ignores it.

sessionId.description: Id of a persisted session record.

name: session-get
